name: Ground Station
description: Full-featured open-source satellite monitoring suite with web UI for satellite tracking, SDR waterfall display, signal decoding, TLE synchronization, antenna rotator control, and multi-SDR device management.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Multi-stage Dockerfile that builds the React frontend and a Python environment with SDR libraries. Supports AMD64 and ARM64 architectures.

eval_notes: Highly popular ground station software with Docker deployment. Agents could manage satellite pass scheduling, configure SDR parameters, decode telemetry, and troubleshoot signal reception issues.
